summary: Frontend-only verification of the 5 design refinements (typography hierarchy, tint bands / visual rhythm, blockquote descriptors, arrow-link micro-interactions, scroll reveal) plus full regression on routes, links, footer, titles and content integrity. design_issues.screen: Home / Assetti / Processi / Finanza (pages ending with a TintBand)
issues: ~240px of empty white space between the bottom of the last tint band and the footer (TintBand my-20/28 + PageContainer pb-24/32 stack). Cosmetic dead space only; consider removing the band's bottom margin when it is the last child.
Header is semi-transparent with backdrop blur, so body text scrolling underneath is faintly visible in the gap between the logo and the nav at 1920px. Pre-existing, low severity.

critical_code_review_comments: FadeIn uses whileInView with viewport {once:true, amount:0.2}; verified no element stays below opacity 0.9 after being scrolled into view on all 10 routes, and with prefers-reduced-motion:reduce everything renders at opacity 1 immediately (initial={false}). No fix needed.

TintBand full-bleed technique (relative left-1/2 w-screen -translate-x-1/2) combined with overflow-x-hidden on the Layout root produces zero horizontal overflow at 1920 and 390 (documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth on all 6 band pages). Note the pattern relies on Layout's overflow-x-hidden; if that class is ever removed, w-screen (100vw) will reintroduce horizontal scroll when a vertical scrollbar is present.
